captions.detailed: An industrial floor-scale air pump featuring a tall, dark gray main cylinder mounted on a rectangular base block. A silver piston rod extends vertically from the top of the cylinder, capped by a T-handle with black padded grips. Near the base, a circular pressure gauge housing with a small red release button is attached, and a telescoping stabilizer bar with black end grips slides horizontally through the lower frame. The T-handle moves prismatically along the cylinder's vertical axis, the stabilizer bar slides prismatically across the base, and the red pressure-release button functions as a prismatic push control.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an industrial floor air pump with a tall central cylinder, a rectangular base block, and a circular pressure gauge housing. Incorporate three prismatic joints: a vertical piston rod with a padded T-handle, a horizontal telescoping stabilizer bar passing through the base, and a small red pressure-release button on the side of the gauge.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a cylinder for the pump body, a box for the base frame, and a cylinder for the pressure gauge. Model the piston rod and T-handle using cylinders for the rod and grip tubes, then set up a vertical prismatic joint. Model the stabilizer bar using horizontal cylinders with black end grips, and define a horizontal prismatic joint through the base. Finally, model the pressure-release button as a small red cylinder on the gauge housing, defining its motion with a third prismatic joint.
